results_both_viewports: Fresh profile: every cast mode normal, rangeOnAttackMove on, showRange C, levelUpMod L Ctrl, viewAlly F2-F5.
Settings > Controls via clicks: Ability 1 set to Quick with indicator and Ability 2 to Quick, showRange rebound to V with the capture button. All three persisted across a reload.
Quick (W, Glare): the cast is sent on keydown.
Normal (W): the press shows the cone aim with its range ring and sends nothing. Left-click casts. Right-click cancels: a move, no cast.
Quick with indicator (Q): holding shows the aim. Right-click while held cancels, and the release sends no cast. Esc while held cancels without opening the menu. A plain release casts.
The rebound V shows the ring at range + radius; C no longer does anything. Arming attack-move shows the ring, and Stop hides it.

Buffer, Q dash then W (quick): W pressed 200 ms before the dash end was held (pendingCast a2) and cast 1 tick after the end. W pressed 533-567 ms before the end (during the windup plus the dash) lapsed at 0.4 s as designed.
HUD: .aslot.is-queued is set on the waiting slot.
Ctrl+Q sends levelUp a1 and no cast. F5 (viewAlly4) in a match does not reload the page.
Right-click still moves or attacks. Shift+left-click sends attackAt with no move after it. 0 console errors.

problems: Hovering an ability slot on the Dial Bar draws no range in the world (renderer aim null, ring null at both viewports); the range shows only once you aim. The genre shows the ability's range on hover. This is outside the plan's Done-when, so it is not a blocker.

Settings > Controls cast-mode rows: the three-way Segmented wraps, with 'Quick with indicator' falling to a second line in 7 of 8 rows at 1920 and all 8 at 1366. Row labels such as 'All abilities', 'Ability 2' and 'Hour spell 1' also break over two lines. It is usable but ragged; a vertical stack or shorter option labels would fix it.
The queued-slot outline (1 px dashed chalk at -4 px offset) is barely visible on the bright W icon at 1920 (dial_queued). It is a weak cue for the 'your press was kept' signal.

Shipping needs a catalog rebuild: with the 2026.11.8 local catalog the new rows read as raw ids ('showRange', 'levelUpMod', 'quickIndicator'), because cv.t falls back to the key, not English. The usual content build at release fixes this. The release must not ship the client without the content step.

A press made during a long windup plus dash (more than 400 ms before the hero is free, e.g. W tapped right after Q on Ardit) lapses silently. This is per spec (0.4 s), but it is the one case where the input is still 'eaten'.
New players default to normal cast on every slot (unchanged from live). Not a defect.
